periods.name: Today
periods.text: S wind around 5 kt, rising to 5 to 10 kt late. Seas 13 to 18 ft, subsiding to 12 to 16 ft this afternoon. Wave Detail: S 2 ft at 8 seconds and W 17 ft at 18 seconds. A slight chance of rain early this morning.

periods.name: Wed Night
periods.text: W wind 10 to 15 kt. Seas 9 to 12 ft. Wave Detail: SW 4 ft at 7 seconds and W 11 ft at 14 seconds. Rain. .....SAN FRANCISCO BAR/FOURFATHOM BANK FORECAST..... IN THE DEEP WATER CHANNEL...Mixed seas of 14 to 17 ft at 17 seconds. ACROSS THE BAR...Swell can be more than twice as high across the bar than surrounding waters. Waves are also more prone to break, particularly during strong ebb currents. Maximum ebb current of 2.3 kt at 06:38 PM Saturday and 0.7 kt at 09:10 AM Sunday.
